name: atlanai-analytics
description: Try Atlan Analytics on a demo or set it up on your own data, step by step: survey dashboards and query history, generate and check metrics, save them locally or to Atlan, ask questions and build a dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Publish analytics context and ask your data with Atlan
interface.longDescription: The analytics workload on the Atlan registry, as six skills. analytics-demo walks through a made-up firm end to end. analytics-build does the same on your own dashboards, BI exports and query history, in seven steps. source-survey says what a source holds and which metric names it offers. metrics-generation generates, checks, edits, proposes and publishes metrics and saved queries with the metrics engine. analytics-ask answers a data question from published metrics, with the definition it used, and turns answers into a dashboard. eval-generation turns the questions a team already asks into an eval set with trusted SQL, saves it to Atlan and tests how many the context answers correctly. It finds your Snowflake, Databricks or other warehouse through Atlan or your own connector, and uses the Atlan plugin's connection.
defaultPrompt: Show me an Atlan Analytics demo
Help me use this dashboard, folder or BI export to ask questions about my data
Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's query history
